details: Chai-as-reformed@1.2.0 is a trojanized logger package that executes remote code on require(). index.js spawns a detached background node process running lib/caller.js, which fetches a payload from hxxps://api[.]jsonstorage[.]net/v1/json/2ef8c758-a96f-459e-b036-b3b90379a165/f89e8264-86c2-4684-94da-c3f82d59370f (sent with an x-secret-key header) and executes the returned.data.cookie value via the Function constructor with require in scope, giving the remote payload full access to the Node.js runtime. The fetched code is attacker-controlled and can run arbitrary commands, read files, or exfiltrate data on the installer's machine.
